subject: Multiple fileInput in Shiny App does not work

messages.author: 9e5b6647683ad4a8
messages.subject: Multiple fileInput in Shiny App does not work
parts:
Hello i want to be able to add 2 separate csv files in my shiny app and produce 2 separate outputs in the main panel but i cannot load them simulataneously. Any suggestions?

library(shiny)


ui <- navbarPage(title = "Multiple Correlation App",
                 
                 tabPanel("Data Import",
                          sidebarLayout(sidebarPanel(
                            fileInput('file1', 'Dataset 1: Choose CSV File to upload',
                                      accept=c('text/csv',
                                               'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain',
                                               '.csv')),
                            helpText("Note: Please ensure that the the file is in .csv",
                                     "format and contains headers."),
                            tags$hr(),
                            actionButton("do", "Import"),
                            fileInput('file2', 'Dataset 2: Choose CSV File to upload',
                                      accept=c('text/csv',
                                               'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain',
                                               '.csv')),
                            helpText("Note: Please ensure that the the file is in .csv",
                                     "format and contains headers."),
                            tags$hr2(),
                            actionButton("do2", "Import")
                           
                           
                           
                          ),
                          mainPanel(h2(helpText("Descriptive Statistics")),
                                    verbatimTextOutput('contents'),
                                    h2(helpText("Descriptive Statistics")),
                                    verbatimTextOutput('contents2')
                                    )
                          )
                 ),#tabpanel
                 tabPanel("Correlations",
                          sidebarLayout(sidebarPanel(),
                          mainPanel()
                          )
                 ),#tabpanel
                 tabPanel("Report",
                          sidebarLayout(sidebarPanel(),
                         
                          mainPanel()
                          )
                 )#tabpanel
                 
                 )
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  hr = eventReactive(input$do,{
    inFile <- input$file1
    
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    
    hr = read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=T, sep=",")
  })
  hr2 = eventReactive(input$do2,{
    inFile2 <- input$file2
    
    if (is.null(inFile2))
      return(NULL)
    
    hr2 = read.csv(inFile2$datapath, header=T, sep=",")
  })

  
  output$contents <- renderPrint({
    return(summary(hr()))
  })
  output$contents2 <- renderPrint({
    return(summary(hr2()))
  })
  
  
}

messages.author: 70dacacdad429db2
messages.subject: Re: Multiple fileInput in Shiny App does not work
parts:
Hello,
Do you mean that you would like to be able to upload two CSV files at the same time instead of having two separate file inputs?

If so, fileInput takes a multiple option which can be used to enable multiple-file uploads.

I also noticed a typo in your code that might have prevented it from working; tags$hr2 is not a function. I posted a version of your code that works for me here: https://gist.github.com/alandipert/3d9a7416a024843542e1edf9ab936345

Alan

Hello,
Do you mean that you would like to be able to upload two CSV files at the same time instead of having two separate file inputs?

Alan
